summary: Autonomous vision analysis identified a compact_block of 18.40 ha (+/- 0.84 ha) at coordinates -9.2550 N, -63.4875 E between 2023-07-18 and 2023-09-26. Investigation mode: offline_simulated. Public records research linked the event to Commercial Agricultural Clearcutting. Investigation status: concluded_with_evidence.
detailed_findings: OpenCV 5 classical computer vision detected a significant forest loss candidate covering 1840 raster pixels (18.40 ha).
